actions.name: redeploy
actions.title: Redeploy
actions.what: Recreates the containers on the live images, so edited settings take effect

actions.name: status
actions.title: Status
actions.what: What's live, what's on GitHub, container health, backups

actions.name: check
actions.title: Check
actions.what: Claude sign-in, Firestore, addresses, Alpaca paper, a test phone alert

actions.name: backup
actions.title: Back up now
actions.what: Copies every database and the inbox to the backup pool

actions.name: restore-test
actions.title: Restore drill
actions.what: Unpacks the newest backup into a scratch folder and checks every database

actions.name: update-script
actions.title: Update box script
actions.what: Copies main's deploy.sh over the one the cron jobs run, once the checkout is clean, at main and the script parses

actions.name: apply-compose
actions.title: Apply compose
actions.what: Backs up, then gives TrueNAS main's compose.yaml, unless the change widens what containers can do
